extracted.name: Slow Cooker Shredded Beef for Tacos and Burritos
extracted.description: Beef simmers in a slow cooker with onion and taco seasoning for a meat filling you can serve in tacos, burritos, taquitos, or whatever other use you can imagine for it.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon seasoned salt, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Place beef roast in crock of a slow cooker. Sprinkle taco seasoning over the beef; top with onion slices.
Remove beef to a cutting board and shred with a pair of forks. Return beef to slow cooker and season with seasoned salt.
